title: Shifting Brilliance, Enochian, Add to the Mix
problem: Compare the spell with the "last spell", which the cast already overwrote with itself: from the 4th spell on they never fire. Community also reports Add to the Mix as buggy.
notes: In-game test: Shifting Brilliance / Enochian / Add to the Mix: cast 5+ spells alternating classes; each spell of a different class than the one before triggers, a same-class repeat does not (needs SU-0123 on). Fix: H: compare with the previous spell

release_notes.effect: Shifting Brilliance, Enochian and Add to the Mix (traits)
release_notes.intended: These trigger when a spell is of a different class than the last spell cast.
release_notes.actual: The game compared against the wrong spell (the current one or the battle's first), so from about the fourth spell on they stopped triggering.
release_notes.fix: Now each cast is compared with the spell cast just before it. Requires SU-0123 (Xyrxzy's Subversion) to be on.
